articles.title: Celebrating Two Michelin Keys for Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong
articles.summary: Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong has been elevated from One Michelin Key to Two Michelin Keys in the Michelin Guide’s 2026 hotel selection, marking a significant milestone just one year after the Michelin Key distinction was first introduced in Hong Kong.

articles.title: Sands China Leads Macao Awardees with Most Restaurants Recognised on Trip.Gourmet's 2027 Fine Dining List
articles.rawDate: Sep.19 Sands China Leads Macao Awardees with Most Restaurants Recognised on Trip.Gourmet's 2027 Fine Dining List
articles.summary: Sands China Ltd. has six signature restaurants on Trip.Gourmet’s 2027 Fine Dining List, the most awardees of any operator in Macao. The Huaiyang Garden at The Londoner Macao received Black Diamond, La Chine at The Parisian Macao received Diamond, and four other venues were named Platinum.

articles.title: Grand Lisboa Palace Becomes Greater China’s First Sustained Carbon-Neutral Integrated MICE Venue
articles.summary: SJM Resorts announced that Grand Lisboa Palace Resort Macau has become the first integrated MICE venue in Greater China to achieve sustained carbon neutrality through high-quality carbon credits. The company also launched Macau’s first standardised Zero-Carbon MICE Service and hosted a Green MICE Forum with more than 150 industry leaders.

articles.title: GEG Wins Four Accolades at the 2026 IAG Academy IR Awards; Including “Best Integrated Resort” for the Fourth Consecutive Year and “Best Individual CSR Initiative”
articles.summary: Galaxy Entertainment Group garnered four awards at the 2026 IAG Academy IR Awards in Manila, making it once again the most awarded integrated resort operator in Macau. Galaxy Macau was named Best Integrated Resort for the fourth consecutive year and Best IR Gaming Floor, Capella at Galaxy Macau was named Best Hotel in an IR for a second year, and the GEG Sports for Good Community Program received Best Individual CSR Initiative.

articles.title: The Parisian Macao Celebrates 10th Anniversary with Exclusive Moët & Chandon Dinners and Stunning Drone Shows
articles.rawDate: Sep.15 The Parisian Macao Celebrates 10th Anniversary with Exclusive Moët & Chandon Dinners and Stunning Drone Shows
articles.summary: To mark a decade of French-inspired hospitality, The Parisian Macao hosted a three-night Moët & Chandon dinner for government officials, VIPs and media. Each evening featured a five-course champagne-paired menu by Moët & Chandon executive chef Jean-Michel Bardet, with 1,500-drone shows over the property’s Eiffel Tower replica.

articles.title: 2026 MSO Sands China Cup – Inclusive Community Basketball Carnival
articles.rawDate: Sep.13 2026 MSO Sands China Cup – Inclusive Community Basketball Carnival
articles.summary: Sands China held the 2026 MSO Sands China Cup – Inclusive Community Basketball Carnival on 13 September at the University of Saint Joseph, attracting over 250 residents from special education schools, community centres and secondary school basketball teams. Co-organized with Macau Special Olympics and the university, the carnival promoted inclusion through basketball ahead of the NBA China Games 2026.

articles.title: The Parisian Macao Celebrates 10th Anniversary
articles.rawDate: Sep.10 The Parisian Macao Celebrates 10th Anniversary
articles.summary: The Parisian Macao marks its 10th anniversary on 13 September. Over the past decade the Cotai landmark has attracted more than 100 million visitors, as Sands China expands non-gaming offerings in support of Macao’s economic diversification.
